prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, super glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size; below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, wolf cut platinum silver hair — wearing a micro police monokini-style costume of ultra-thin supple jet-black lambskin nappa leather, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back with a silver badge on the left cup, joined to the skirt by two thin vertical straps of the same lambskin about two fingers apart that run down on either side of her navel from the lower corners of the cups to the waistband, linked by three small horizontal straps with polished silver buckles stacked down the center of her stomach, a pair of silver handcuffs clipped at her right hip, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the skirt a micro mini of the same lambskin with a narrow waistband at the top of her hip bones, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the skirt from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the lambskin shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin lambskin molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the silver badge, the polished buckles and the clipped handcuffs gleaming against the black nappa, fine stretch creases and a soft satin leather sheen. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in black lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.

Background: the wide granite courtyard of Gyeongbokgung Palace with a standard-height palace gate, low stone steps and a waist-high stone balustrade, empty of visitors, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
